origin: cwe/89/csharp Taint Sinks: ExecuteSqlRaw() with string interpolation in SQL construction

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The non-query EF Core update uses ExecuteSqlRawAsync() with accountId and status already interpolated into the SQL string; only beforeUtc is passed separately.

trap: Passing beforeUtc separately and assuming the call is parameterized, or replacing ExecuteSqlRawAsync with ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync after keeping the prebuilt interpolated string. Every user-controlled value must be represented as a parameter at the point SQL is formed.
must_preserve: The method still archives matching orders and returns the affected-row count. AccountId, Status, and BeforeUtc remain separate query values rather than changing the archival criteria.
